answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. Like water carving a deep canyon into a limestone karst, the financial weight of staked assets forces agents to prove skin-in-the-game. An attacker attempting to swarm the network with fake identities faces a falcon of punitive slashing, as deploying fragmented capital across multiple nodes incurs prohibitive opportunity costs that outweigh the potential illicit gains from consensus subversion.
